question: The era of five-year plans began in India with the establishment of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Planning Commission. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Planning Commission** was established in** 1950 **to formulate and implement **economic plans** and policies for the country.
 
• It was responsible for creating **five-year plans **for the development of various sectors in India.
 
• The first five-year plan was launched in **1951** and focused on **agriculture, irrigation, power, and transport. **
 
• Subsequent plans addressed issues such as **poverty alleviation, industrialization, and education.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by the** NITI Aayog in 2015**.

 
 
• The new organization is responsible for providing **strategic and technical advice** to the government on various policy matters.
 
 
 
• The **Parliament** is the supreme legislative body of India, consisting of the** President, the Rajya Sabha** (Council of States), and the **Lok Sabha** (House of the People).
 
 
• It is responsible for** enacting laws **and overseeing the functioning of the government.
 
 
 
• The** Finance Commission** is a constitutional body that is responsible for recommending the distribution of **tax revenues** between the central and state governments.
 
 
• It is also responsible for recommending measures to improve the** financial position** of the states.
